description: This Java class defines a SQL statement for modifying existing table columns within the context of Liquibase, an database schema change management tool. It encapsulates details such as schema name, table name, and column configurations, and extends the abstract SQL statement class.

classes.name: ModifyColumnStatement
classes.description: A class representing a SQL statement to modify existing columns in a database table, including schema name, table name, and column configurations.

methods.name: ModifyColumnStatement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the statement with the schema name, table name, and columns to be modified.

methods.name: getSchemaName
methods.description: Returns the schema name associated with this modify column statement.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the target table name for the modification.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of column configurations to be modified.
